verdict.rationale: Conta Simples documents most of this story. It offers categories, cost centers and suppliers to classify transactions, receipts and invoices can be linked to transactions, and transactions can be updated and reconciled. Marketing also claims each payment appears already categorized by area, owner and expense type, with real-time management. Missing for 10: any documented memo/notes field on transactions, receipt capture at the point of purchase (receipts are only linked to existing transactions), clear evidence that merchant data is captured automatically, and independent or hands-on corroboration of coding at transaction time.

support.subject: As a finance lead, spend is coded as it happens — merchant, category, memo, receipt — so month-end close is a review, not an archaeology dig

citations.quote: Personalize a plataforma para que cada pagamento já apareça devidamente categorizado por área, responsável e tipo de despesa.
List, create, rename, and delete categories to classify transactions.
Manage suppliers to classify and reconcile company expenses.
Link receipts and invoices to existing transactions and download the linked files.
Access card and bank statements, download receipts, update and reconcile transactions.
